title: Electron speed in the Bohr model
hook: Change principal quantum number and predict electron speed.
misconception: electron speed doubles when principal quantum number doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply v_n ∝ 1/n to compare electron speed when principal quantum number changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the nonrelativistic Bohr model of hydrogen with allowed positive integer levels, v_n ∝ 1/n. When principal quantum number doubles, electron speed becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model v_n ∝ 1/n; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the nonrelativistic Bohr model of hydrogen with allowed positive integer levels, with a nonzero initial result. If principal quantum number triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on electron speed?
recall.why: Apply v_n ∝ 1/n under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
